Mariner.description: A crew member or shore staff of the ferry company. A first name alone is not an identity.

Vessel.description: One ferry in the fleet, whoever crews it.

Terminal.description: A pier, slip or quay a ferry sails from or to.

Crewing.description:
Which post a mariner holds aboard a vessel: master in command, mate on deck, or engineer below.
Sailing aboard is not holding a post.

Route.description: How a vessel uses a terminal: the port it is based at, or a terminal it calls at on its run.

Sailing.description: One scheduled crossing. origin is where it departs, destination where it lands.

Incident.description: A safety event aboard a vessel. reported_by filed it, injured was hurt, witness saw it.

questions.q: Who is the skipper of Morven Star?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Vessel)-[:skipper]->(n1:Mariner) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Morven Star' RETURN n1.crew_name AS crew_name

questions.q: Which vessel am I the master of?
questions.speaker: aroha_n
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mariner)-[:master]->(n1:Vessel) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.hull_name AS hull_name

questions.q: Who are the engineers of Morven Star?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Vessel)-[:engineers]->(n1:Mariner) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Morven Star' RETURN n1.crew_name AS crew_name

questions.q: What is the home port of Morven Star?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Vessel)-[:home_port]->(n1:Terminal) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Morven Star' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which vessels are calling at Skelda Terminal?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Terminal)-[:calling]->(n1:Vessel) WHERE n0.name = 'Skelda Terminal' RETURN n1.hull_name AS hull_name

questions.q: Is there a record that the Gannet Belle incident was logged to the coastguard?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Vessel)<-[:vessel]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Gannet Belle' RETURN coalesce(n1.logged_to_coastguard, false) AS logged_to_coastguard

questions.q: Was the Kittiwake incident logged to the coastguard?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Vessel)<-[:vessel]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Kittiwake' RETURN n1.logged_to_coastguard AS logged_to_coastguard

questions.q: How many passengers were aboard during the incidents I reported?
questions.speaker: femi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mariner)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:Incident) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.passengers_aboard AS passengers_aboard

questions.q: Who witnessed the incident reported by Siobhan Kearney?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mariner)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:Incident)-[:witness]->(n2:Mariner) WHERE n0.crew_name = 'Siobhan Kearney' RETURN n2.crew_name AS crew_name

questions.q: How many vehicles were booked on sailings leaving Inchmurrin Slip?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Terminal)<-[:origin]-(n1:Sailing) WHERE n0.name = 'Inchmurrin Slip' RETURN n1.vehicles AS vehicles

questions.q: How severe was the incident on the stairs?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.detail CONTAINS 'stairs' RETURN n0.severity AS severity

questions.q: What state is each sailing in, and how many vehicles does it carry?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Sailing) RETURN n0.state AS state, n0.vehicles AS vehicles

questions.q: What is the email of Siobhan Kearney?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mariner) WHERE n0.crew_name = 'Siobhan Kearney' RETURN n0.email AS email

questions.q: Who was injured aboard Saltire Rose?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Vessel)<-[:vessel]-(n1:Incident)-[:injured]->(n2:Mariner) WHERE n0.hull_name = 'Saltire Rose' RETURN n2.crew_name AS crew_name

questions.q: Which vessel is Siobhan Kearney master of?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Mariner)-[:master]->(n1:Vessel) WHERE n0.crew_name = 'Siobhan Kearney' RETURN n1.hull_name AS hull_name
